page.overview:
What is Verity Lakefront?

Verity Lakefront is a location in Pokémon Diamond Version and Pokémon Pearl Version, Pokémon Platinum Version, and the remakes Pokémon Brilliant Diamond and Pokémon Shining Pearl. It is a small area between Route 201 and Lake Verity, where it leads into. In Diamond and Pearl, the player obtains his/her first Pokémon here. Later in the game, the player defeats the Team Galactic Commander Mars here.

Potion sprite; Potion; D/P; Hidden on the raised piece of land, one space north of the southernmost flower. Tiny Mushroom sprite; Tiny Mushroom; Pt; Hidden on the raised piece of land, one space north of the southernmost flower (replaces the Potion in Diamond and Pearl).
